<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Encanto em Fios | Crochê</title>
<style>
:root{--rose:#9d536c;--dark:#30262b;--cream:#fff9f7;--line:#eadcdf;--muted:#75696d}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0} body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--cream);color:var(--dark)}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:#fffaf9ee;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:15px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;color:var(--rose)} nav a{text-decoration:none;color:#55484c;margin-left:18px;font-size:14px}
.hero{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:70px 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:45px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{color:var(--rose);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,72px);line-height:1.02;margin:12px 0 18px}
.hero p{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);max-width:600px;margin-bottom:25px}
.btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--rose);color:white;text-decoration:none;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:30px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 10px 25px #9d536c30}
.hero-art{border-radius:30px;padding:12px;background:#f1e0e4;box-shadow:0 20px 50px #6b465020}
.hero-art img{width:100%;height:420px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:22px;display:block}
section{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:55px 20px}
.title{text-align:center;margin-bottom:32px} .title h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:36px} .title p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:7px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.card{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #6b465012}
.card img{width:100%;height:230px;object-fit:cover;display:block} .card div{padding:17px}
.card h3{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:8px} .card a{color:var(--rose);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:14px}
.about{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:25px;padding:38px;text-align:center}
.about p{max-width:720px;margin:12px auto 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:16px}
.info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:15px;margin-top:22px}
.info div{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:22px;border-radius:18px;text-align:center}
.info strong{display:block;margin-bottom:6px} .info span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.contact{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:48px 20px;text-align:center}
.contact p{color:#e8dce0;margin:10px auto 22px} .contact .btn{background:#fff;color:var(--rose)}
footer{text-align:center;padding:28px 20px;color:#8a7d81;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:750px){nav a{display:none}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:48px}.hero-art img{height:330px}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.info{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:480px){.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card img{height:260px}}
</style></head><body>
<header><nav><div class="brand">Encanto em Fios 🧶</div><div>
<a href="#inicio">Início</a><a href="#pecas">Peças</a><a href="#sobre">Sobre</a><a href="#pedido">Pedido</a>
</div></nav></header>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="inicio"><div>
<div class="eyebrow">Crochê artesanal ✨</div>
<h1>Encanto em cada ponto.</h1>
<p>Peças artesanais feitas em crochê, com carinho e atenção em cada detalhe.</p>
<a class="btn" href="https://instagram.com/encantoemfios_atelie_" target="_blank">Fazer pedido pelo Direct →</a>
</div>
<div class="hero-art"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
